budget.counted: every real HTTP request of the LG official adapters and Sulpak (retries included); a sitemap answered from the in-process cache is not a request
budget.refusal: a request over budget is refused before it is made (marker [policy_budget_exhausted]) and the row records it

stop_rule: any 401/403/429 or confirmed challenge (any HTTP status) stops that host in the persisted log (workdir/lg_fetch_log.json); the pilot halts before the next row and lists rows not run
workflow: the ordinary worker.run_once(database) with the default adapter factories (LGAdapter, LGRUAdapter, SulpakAdapter through PolicyAwareSession; DNS default), stages 1,2,3,4,6, one job per row

dealer_check.reading: DNS and Sulpak fetch only URLs listed in their KNOWN_URLS maps; a row not listed there makes no dealer request

measured_per_row: official exact page found (lg_kz, lg_ru: match level and url)
specification facts per source and resolved statuses
photos per source and kind (gallery / feature / excluded)
instructions found and their stated language
what Sulpak and DNS added (facts, photos, match level)
card readiness by the rule below
failure codes from the taxonomy below
the requests made (url, status) and the responses saved for offline diagnosis

readiness_rule.export_ready: job status done AND an official page whose article matches the full row article (match_level full_sku, no error) AND >=1 official specification fact AND >=1 official gallery photo (kind product_gallery, not excluded, selected for export) AND >=1 instruction whose language is stated as Russian by the source AND no unresolved conflict
readiness_rule.export_ready_with_gaps: official full_sku page AND >=1 official specification fact AND >=1 official gallery photo, but at least one of: instruction missing, supplier confirmation missing, job not done, unresolved conflict -- the gaps are listed
readiness_rule.not_ready: anything else (no official full_sku page, or no official specifications, or no official gallery photo)
readiness_rule.note: `done` is never read as readiness by itself; the job status is reported next to the rule's verdict.

failure_taxonomy.kz_sitemap_error: LG Kazakhstan: the sitemap could not be fetched or parsed (error on the sitemap request)
failure_taxonomy.kz_no_slug_in_sitemap: LG Kazakhstan: mismatch, 'page not found in the LG sitemap' -- no product URL whose slug equals the article or its base model
failure_taxonomy.kz_page_unrecognised: LG Kazakhstan: a page was fetched but lacks the expected product-card markup
failure_taxonomy.kz_base_model_only: LG Kazakhstan: page found for the base model, full article not on the page
failure_taxonomy.kz_page_error: LG Kazakhstan: HTTP error on a product page
failure_taxonomy.ru_no_page: LG Russia: HTTP error on the single URL the adapter builds (https://www.lg.com/ru/laundry/lg-{model})
failure_taxonomy.ru_page_unrecognised: LG Russia: a page came back without the expected markup
failure_taxonomy.ru_base_model_only: LG Russia: page found, only the base model on it
failure_taxonomy.documents_no_support_link: instructions: the RU page was read but no support-model link was extracted (the extraction only recognises one support model name)
failure_taxonomy.documents_not_checked: instructions: not attempted because there was no usable LG Russia page
failure_taxonomy.documents_none_ru: instructions: support page read, no document labelled Russian
failure_taxonomy.supplier_no_candidate: Sulpak: no bounded candidate URL for the article (it only fetches URLs listed in adapters/sulpak.KNOWN_LG_URLS)
failure_taxonomy.no_supplier_confirmation_so_not_done: worker rule: without a trusted-supplier full_sku confirmation an LG job finishes needs_review, never done
failure_taxonomy.budget_exhausted: the pilot's request budget refused a request
failure_taxonomy.host_stopped: a host was stopped by the policy (block) -- the pilot halts

export_check: after the pilot the ordinary Excel export (exporter.export_batch) is produced for the pilot batch and counted per row
not_done_here: the full run of the 578 rows
